selection_rule: val Macro_F1, then lower MAOE, then CV Macro_F1, then shallower tree; no test selection

cv.upstream_selection_limitation: Top-25 fixed upstream using all train labels; internal CV is not fully nested

interval.method: 5/50/95 percentiles of individual tree point predictions
interval.warning: Tree spread is not calibrated outcome uncertainty; not a Quantile Regression Forest

spec_clarifications: spec 4.2 says M6 for concentration interval; implemented on M5 because M6 predicts levels/probabilities
spec 4.4 says no baseline meets both gates, but its own M3 val numbers 0.8744/0.2822 meet them
Only proba arrays have shape (n,4); labels/timestamps/row IDs have shape (n,)
M5 tuned thresholds calibrated once on seed42 val and fixed for seeds43/44; labels always use 15/35/55
M6 uses balanced_subsample; comparison includes both decomposition and changed binary class weights

refactor.scope: readability-only refactor; real fitted models and result arrays unchanged
